description: Upload an image from a file on this computer to a draft listing. role is banner (wide, at least 1600 px across), logo (square, at least 512 px) or screenshot (at least 1600 px across). A banner or logo replaces the existing one; screenshots are added. altText is required: describe what the image shows. PNG, JPEG, WebP or AVIF up to 8 MB. Works on live listings too: a logo or screenshot publishes at once, and a banner goes through the same review as the dashboard.

altText.description: What the image shows, up to 300 characters

path.description: Path of the image file on the local machine

name: upload_listing_image
